text: I'm sorry, I don't really know how to describe this. My grandson is 4 months old and his crying has changed tonight. It's not his normal cry. It's thin and sort of squeaky, higher than usual, and it doesn't stop properly, it just goes on and on in this weak way, not like when he's hungry or tired. I might be imagining it but it frightened me. He's got a few insect bites on his arms that seem itchy, I don't know if that's anything to do with it. His mum is on her way. Should I be doing something now?
